description: 2,229 real IT support tickets from an IT support company in the Florianopolis (Brazil) region, typed by the users who opened them, labelled into 7 categories by three IT professionals in 2020, PII replaced by tags such as [NAME].
fetch: python scripts/fetch_zenodo_tickets.py (md5-pinned; pickles and model not downloaded)
committed: mapping_review_samples.csv (15 ticket texts, the evidence for the mapping decision)
routing_results.csv (ids, predictions and similarities; no ticket text)
realworld_summary*.csv, realworld_by_source*.csv, realworld_confusion*.csv (scripts/score_realworld.py; no ticket text)
drafts.json and drafts_raw/<id>.json (scripts/draft_realworld.py; 30 ticket texts with their Gemini drafts and retrieved synthetic context)
